description: This file defines the Application class for an Android app, setting up dependency injection with Koin, configuring notifications, initializing error reporting with ACRA, and enqueuing periodic background workers.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Custom Application class initializing dependency injection, notification channels, background workers, strict mode, and error reporting for the Android app.

methods.name: newImageLoader
methods.description: Creates and configures a Coil ImageLoader with caching and decoders.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes Koin, notification channels, and background workers on application startup.

methods.name: attachBaseContext
methods.description: Sets up ACRA crash reporting with specified configuration.

methods.name: createNotificationChannels
methods.description: Creates notification channels for devices running Android Oreo and above.

methods.name: enqueueWorkers
methods.description: Schedules periodic background work using WorkManager.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Enables strict mode policies for debugging.
